name: playwright-mcp
description: > **Playwright MCP** is a [Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/) server built on top of [Playwright](https://playwright.dev/). It lets AI assistants (GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, etc.) directly control a real browser — clicking, typing, navigating, taking screenshots and running assertions — all through natural-language instructions.
